description: AI models trained on the C4 dataset exhibit negative biases toward Arab individuals.

AI models trained on virology papers may be better able to assist in harmful biology tasks.
AI models trained on large datasets can exhibit emergent capabilities that were not explicitly programmed by their developers.
AI models trained on clean speech perform poorly on noisy speech, yet often remain highly confident in their erroneous classifications.
AI models trained on massive, uncurated internet datasets inevitably learn and reflect the biases, cruelty, and harmful attitudes present in that data.
